scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/staff && npm run build -w apps/portal
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @blackford/core && npm run typecheck -w @blackford/db && npm run typecheck -w @blackford/worker
scripts.env:init: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');for (const a of ['staff','portal']){const d=p.join('apps',a);const src=p.join(d,'.env.example');const dest=p.join(d,'.env.local');if(!fs.existsSync(dest)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);console.log('created',dest);}else{console.log('exists',dest);}}const w='apps/worker/.env';if(!fs.existsSync(w)){fs.copyFileSync('apps/worker/.env.example',w);console.log('created',w);}else{console.log('exists',w);}}"
